entities.summary: Mogho Naba, a notable figure in the history of Burkina Faso, associated with Mossi Kingdoms (1050–1896). Preceded by Kingdom of Ouagadougou (Wogodogo). Their legacy influenced Kingdom of Yatenga and Northern Mossi.
